bug_semantics: Community-tier harden-runner (non-TLS step-security/agent) enforces egress-policy:block with iptables domain allowlisting. addBlockRules always ACCEPTs all TCP to resolver IPs (originally 8.8.8.8, later also 8.8.4.4 and 1.1.1.1) so the agent can resolve names over HTTPS/DoH, with no owner-UID match and no --dport 443 restriction. Any workflow process can therefore open HTTPS to those resolver IPs (e.g. 8.8.8.8:443 / dns.google DoH), encode exfil as DNS labels, and bypass allowed-endpoints. Enterprise agent-ebpf is unchanged and out of scope. Requires code execution in the job.
flaw_origin: The hole is the Community agent's implicit TCP ACCEPT for DNS-resolver IPs in addBlockRules, first written in step-security/agent@c793555005be99a734737f7bf8ebce54e545f3c6 (2021-11-15 firewall.go: dnsServerIP=8.8.8.8 plus comment 'Agent uses HTTPs to resolve domain names' / 'Allow 8.8.8.8 for dns', ipt.Append ACCEPT for all TCP, no UID). The same unrestricted ACCEPT survived (expanded to a dnsServers slice in #414) through agent v0.14.3, which harden-runner Community pinned until v2.15.1.

reasoning: CVE-2026-32947 / GHSA-46g3-37rh-v698 is a live published Community-tier protection-mechanism failure, not withdrawn. The action itself only downloads a pinned Community agent; v2.15.1->v2.16.0 changes that pin from agent v0.14.3 to v0.14.4 while leaving the Enterprise eBPF agent untouched. In the Community agent, egress-policy:block installs iptables ACCEPTs for resolver IPs so the agent can DoH-resolve names. Those ACCEPTs were process-wide and port-unrestricted, so job code can speak HTTPS to 8.8.8.8/8.8.4.4/1.1.1.1 (Google/Cloudflare DoH) and exfiltrate via DNS labels without matching allowed-endpoints. The first public write of that ACCEPT is agent@c793555005be99a734737f7bf8ebce54e545f3c6 firewall.go; the parent tree has no firewall.go, so introducer_parent_absent is false and this is a valid first-write BIC (not a move/squash of reconstructable members). AI is judged only on that BIC object: human Varun Sharma author and committer, message 'First commit', no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/bot identity, dated 2021-11-15. The product-facing fix is harden-runner v2.16.0 (fa2e9d605c4eeb9fcad4c99c224cee0c6c7f3594), whose direct member 72f50d46fb446c15066338ef08ea5d11593570eb pins agent v0.14.4; that agent release applies UID+dport 443 restriction (7edc21b80b1df77131ce3dde5bfc450a7c20cd97).
